title: ReProbe: Efficient Test-Time Scaling of Multi-Step Reasoning by Probing Internal States of Large Language Models
authors_zh: Jingwei Ni、Ekaterina Fadeeva、Tianyi Wu 等（机构：ETH Zürich、National University of Singapore、MBZUAI、University of Zürich、The University of Melbourne）
paper_type_zh: 步骤级验证与高效测试时扩展研究（ACL 2026）
best_for_zh: 希望降低最佳候选或束搜索推理中验证器成本的读者。
one_line: ReProbe uses a small probe over a frozen LLM’s internal states to verify reasoning steps during test-time scaling.
ReProbe 用冻结语言模型的内部状态训练小型探针，在测试时扩展中验证推理步骤。
why: It makes step verification depend on signals already produced by the generator, reducing the cost of allocating inference computation.
inclusion_reason: It replaces a large external process reward model with a lightweight verifier that changes step-level inference-time search and selection.

title: Problem
问题
html:
Multi-step reasoning can benefit from sampling alternative continuations and rejecting weak steps during inference, but this requires a reliable step-level scorer. Process reward models are a common solution, yet they are often large additional language models, expensive to train, expensive to run beside the generator, and specialized to the domain on which their annotations were collected. A deployment that spends more compute on branching may therefore lose much of the gain to its verifier overhead.

The paper asks whether the generator already contains enough information to assess the credibility of its own reasoning steps. It seeks a verifier that can guide Best-of-N and beam-search scaling without re-generating textual judgments through another large model. The desired signal must be cheap, generalize beyond one reasoning domain, and remain usable while the base reasoner itself stays frozen.

多步推理可以通过在推理时采样替代延续并拒绝薄弱步骤而受益，但这需要可靠的步骤级评分器。过程奖励模型是常见方案，然而它们往往是额外的大型语言模型，训练成本高、与生成器并行运行时成本高，并且常局限于收集标注的领域。因此，一个把更多计算花在分支上的部署，可能会把大部分收益损失在验证器开销上。

论文追问：生成器本身是否已包含足以评估自身推理步骤可信度的信息。它寻求一种能引导最佳候选与束搜索扩展的验证器，而无需让另一个大模型重新生成文本判断。理想信号必须廉价、能跨出单一推理领域泛化，并且在基础推理器保持冻结时仍可使用。

title: Core idea
核心思路
html:
ReProbe treats a language model’s own hidden states, attention patterns, and logits as evidence about the quality of the reasoning step currently being generated. A small transformer-based probe reads those internal features from a frozen base model and predicts the probability that a step is credible. The verifier therefore reuses information generated in the ordinary decoding process rather than asking an external reward model to judge the step from text alone.

This changes the economics of test-time scaling. The system can assign scores to candidate steps and retain or reject trajectories using a module with fewer than ten million parameters, while conventional process reward models may contain billions. The paper also permits either larger-model annotations or self-supervised annotations for probe training, aiming to combine the low serving cost of uncertainty-style signals with the supervised accuracy associated with process verification.

ReProbe 将语言模型自身的隐藏状态、注意力模式和 logits 视为正在生成的推理步骤质量的证据。一个小型 Transformer 探针读取冻结基础模型的这些内部特征，并预测该步骤可信的概率。因此，验证器复用普通解码过程中已产生的信息，而不是要求外部奖励模型只根据文本判断步骤。

这改变了测试时扩展的经济性。系统可用一个不足一千万参数的模块为候选步骤打分，并保留或拒绝轨迹，而传统过程奖励模型可能包含数十亿参数。论文还允许用更大模型标注或自监督标注来训练探针，目标是结合不确定性式信号的低服务成本与过程验证的监督准确性。

title: Method
方法
html:
The authors generate chain-of-thought trajectories from a target LLM, divide them into reasoning steps, and obtain step-correctness labels either from DeepSeek-R1 or from the target model itself. The target LLM remains frozen. ReProbe extracts hidden states or attention-and-logit features from its generation, projects them, processes them with transformer layers, aggregates token features over each step, and trains a binary credibility classifier with class weighting.

At inference time the probe supplies a score for every candidate step. Those scores can replace a process reward model in step-level beam search or be aggregated to rank complete trajectories in Best-of-N selection. The paper reports training on 10.8K PRM800K prompts with three generated trajectories per prompt, and evaluates across mathematics, planning, and general-knowledge question answering, making the test-time decision record explicit: candidate step, internal signal, probe score, retained branch, and final answer.

作者从目标语言模型生成思维链轨迹，将其划分为推理步骤，并由 DeepSeek-R1 或目标模型自身获得步骤正确性标签。目标语言模型保持冻结。ReProbe 从其生成中抽取隐藏状态，或注意力与 logits 特征，对其投影、用 Transformer 层处理、在每个步骤上聚合词元特征，再以类别加权训练二元可信度分类器。

在推理时，探针为每个候选步骤提供分数。这些分数可替代过程奖励模型用于步骤级束搜索，或聚合后为最佳候选选择中的完整轨迹排序。论文报告使用 PRM800K 的一万零八百个提示、每题三条生成轨迹训练，并在数学、规划和常识问答上评估，使推理时决策记录明确为：候选步骤、内部信号、探针分数、保留分支和最终答案。

title: Evidence
证据
html:
The ACL paper evaluates probes on mathematics, planning, and general-knowledge QA, including both in-domain and out-of-domain settings. It reports that probes with fewer than 10M parameters match or exceed process reward models much larger than themselves in step verification and test-time scaling; the paper highlights comparisons to PRMs up to 810 times larger. This supports the paper’s central claim that internal states carry usable credibility information for reasoning processes.

The evidence is not merely a classifier score: ReProbe is inserted into the decisions that determine which candidates continue in beam search or which completed trace is selected. The paper also reports automatically constructed, self-supervised training data as a lower-cost option. Nevertheless, model internals and step boundaries vary by architecture and prompting format, so the reported efficiency should be checked with the actual base model, feature extraction cost, and domain shift that a deployment expects.

ACL 论文在数学、规划和常识问答上评估探针，包含域内与域外设定。它报告，不足一千万参数的探针能在步骤验证和测试时扩展中达到或超过远大于自身的过程奖励模型；论文特别强调与最多大八百一十倍的 PRM 的比较。这支持了论文的核心主张：内部状态携带可用于推理过程可信度的信号。

证据不只是分类器分数：ReProbe 被插入到决定束搜索中哪些候选继续、或最佳候选中选择哪条完整轨迹的决策里。论文还报告自动构造的自监督训练数据作为低成本选项。不过，模型内部特征与步骤边界随架构和提示格式而变化，因此报告的效率仍应在部署实际使用的基础模型、特征抽取成本和预期领域偏移下检查。

title: Novelty
新意
html:
The distinctive move is to make introspection operational in a test-time search loop. Rather than train another full language model to read a chain of thought externally, ReProbe uses features already exposed inside the generator to estimate step correctness. The important change is not only parameter count: it changes the source of verifier evidence from generated text plus a separate model to the base reasoner’s own computational state.

The work also connects this small verifier to both parallel and sequential candidate decisions. The same probe can score a partial continuation in beam search or contribute to complete-trajectory selection, which makes it a reusable control signal for extra inference computation. By supporting external and self-supervised annotations, the method further separates the choice of training-label provider from the expensive model that must run during every deployed inference.

独特之处在于让内省在推理时搜索循环中成为实际操作。ReProbe 不训练另一个完整语言模型从外部阅读思维链，而是利用生成器内部已经暴露的特征估计步骤正确性。重要改变不只是参数量：验证证据的来源从生成文本加独立模型，变成基础推理器自身的计算状态。

工作还把这个小验证器连接到并行与串行的候选决策。同一个探针既可在束搜索中为局部延续打分，也可参与完整轨迹选择，使其成为额外推理计算的可复用控制信号。通过支持外部与自监督标注，方法还把训练标签提供者的选择，与每次部署推理中必须运行的昂贵模型分离开来。

title: Limitations
局限
html: ReProbe requires access to internal states, attention, or logits, so it is not directly applicable to closed APIs that expose only text. Its step labels may inherit systematic errors from a larger annotator or from self-annotation, and the definition of a reasoning “step” can be fragile for native thinking models or unconstrained prose. Although the probe is small, extracting and retaining the required generator features still has a serving cost. Cross-domain results are encouraging, but each new model family should be audited for calibration, feature availability, and whether probe confidence tracks true future answer quality.
ReProbe 需要访问内部状态、注意力或 logits，因此不能直接用于只暴露文本的闭源接口。其步骤标签可能继承更大标注器或自标注的系统性错误，而推理“步骤”的定义对原生思考模型或不受约束的散文也可能脆弱。尽管探针很小，抽取并保留所需生成器特征仍有服务成本。跨领域结果令人鼓舞，但每个新模型家族都应审计其校准、特征可得性，以及探针置信度是否追踪真实的未来答案质量。

title: Usefulness
用途
html: Use ReProbe when the generator is locally hosted and a separate PRM dominates the latency or memory budget of a reasoning system. Record the source and layer of internal features, step-segmentation rule, label provider, probe score, branch decision, total feature-extraction overhead, and final correctness. Compare it against an outcome-only selector and a full PRM under matched candidate counts. It is especially useful for deciding whether a model’s own hidden computation can replace an external verifier before scaling beam width or Best-of-N further.
当生成器本地托管、而独立 PRM 主导推理系统的延迟或内存预算时，可使用 ReProbe。应记录内部特征的来源与层、步骤划分规则、标签提供者、探针分数、分支决策、总特征抽取开销和最终正确性；并在匹配候选数下与结果级选择器和完整 PRM 比较。它尤其适合在进一步扩大束宽或最佳候选数之前，判断模型自身的隐藏计算能否替代外部验证器。

title: Reading notes
阅读笔记
html: Read the training-data construction and feature-extraction pipeline as carefully as the final benchmark table. Check which internal layers and token features are used, how a step is segmented, whether labels come from an external judge or self-supervision, and how a sequence of step scores becomes a trajectory score. A faithful reproduction should hold the generator and candidate budget fixed while replacing only the verifier, then report step calibration, selection accuracy, GPU memory, feature-extraction latency, and out-of-domain behavior. This separates genuine search improvement from savings caused by a weaker or differently instrumented comparator.
阅读时应像看最终基准表一样仔细检查训练数据构造与特征抽取流程。需要核对使用了哪些内部层和词元特征、如何划分步骤、标签来自外部评审还是自监督，以及一串步骤分数如何变成轨迹分数。忠实复现应固定生成器与候选预算，只替换验证器，然后报告步骤校准、选择准确率、GPU 内存、特征抽取延迟和域外行为。这能把真正的搜索改进与较弱或不同仪器化比较器带来的节省区分开。
